name: ampm-platform
description: AMPM wedding platform: public website, client and team apps, API. Design package in docs/, code in apps/ and packages/.

scripts.check: turbo run lint typecheck test && pnpm run test:tools
scripts.test:tools: python3 docs/tools/redact_secrets.py --self-test && bash docs/tools/memory_hook_test.sh && bash docs/tools/setup_memory_test.sh && bash docs/tools/mempalace_global_hook_test.sh && python3 docs/tools/install_global_memory_hooks_test.py && bash docs/tools/checkpoint_test.sh
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm --filter api exec prisma migrate dev
scripts.infra:config: docker compose -f infra/compose/local/compose.yml config -q && AMPM_IMAGE=config-check AMPM_DOMAIN=config-check ACME_EMAIL=ops@example.com docker compose -f infra/compose/production/compose.yml config -q && AMPM_IMAGE=config-check AMPM_DOMAIN=config-check ACME_EMAIL=ops@example.com docker compose -f infra/compose/staging/compose.yml config -q
scripts.prepare: turbo run build --filter=@ampm/tokens --filter=@ampm/core --filter=@ampm/policy && (if git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then lefthook install; fi)
